objective: Split-Cell Lock Toggle + Assignment Modal Lock Control
must_haves: SplitCell exposes a clickable lock/unlock affordance that calls onLockToggle, mirroring the non-split cell; the whole assignment is the unit of locking (single isLocked boolean, existing POST /assignments/:id/lock, no backend change)
onLockToggle is threaded from the AssignmentCell exported component into SplitCell (previously silently dropped)

Split-cell lock affordance follows the three cases: canEdit && isLocked -> visible clickable lock; canEdit && !isLocked -> hover-visible clickable lock; !canEdit && isLocked -> static icon (no button)
The lock button onClick calls e.stopPropagation() so cell onCellClick does not fire
AssignmentModal shows a lock/unlock toggle button (footer, near Delete) driven by assignment.isLocked read from the prop (not local state); clicking it calls useToggleLock().mutate(assignment.id)
While assignment.isLocked is true, all editable form fields, the Save button, and the Delete button are disabled, but the lock-toggle button itself remains enabled so the user can unlock
Existing backend lock/edit/delete guards and NORMAL-role access are unchanged (frontend-only plan)
